payload.title: The pipeline cannot widen its own permissions without an approval
payload.description:
```gherkin
Feature: Changing the pipeline's roles needs a person's approval

  Scenario: Ordinary deploys cannot touch the pipeline's roles
    Given the deploy role and the CloudFormation service role
    When a normal stack deploy runs
    Then neither role can change the humorus-github-deploy stack, the OIDC provider or the pipeline roles

  Scenario: A roles change waits for an approval
    Given a merged change to infra/stacks/github-deploy.yaml
    When the Deploy workflow reaches the pipeline-roles job
    Then the job waits for a person to approve it in the GitHub environment pipeline-roles
    And only after approval does the roles-apply role update that one stack through the roles service role
```
